name: orchestrator
description: Macro orchestration capability — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble + same-host dispatch into engineer, lifecycle closure, and workflow-continuity meta surfaces for AI-assisted development across Claude Code & Codex CLI. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1, ADR-0019 cross-plugin invocation).

interface.shortDescription: Macro orchestration — multi-deliverable plan, dispatch, lifecycle closure, and continuity meta skills
interface.longDescription: L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition + ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1 + ADR-0019 cross-plugin invocation contract. First multi-verb L2 occupant (single-verb capability precedent ADR-0010 §3 does not apply). Provides /orchestrator:plan (macro plan + Plan-verify Codex ensemble), /orchestrator:next (same-host dispatch into engineer with branch precondition + parent-linkage env vars), /orchestrator:done (idempotent backup for engineer Stop auto-writeback), /orchestrator:finalize and /orchestrator:abort (macro terminal lifecycle), /orchestrator:resume / checkpoint / peer-now workflow-continuity meta commands, and /orchestrator:audit as a follow-up planning alias that canonicalizes to /orchestrator:plan. Codex skills mirror plan, next, done, finalize, abort, resume, checkpoint, and peer-now; audit remains a Claude sugar alias for plan follow-up. Single Responsibility: orchestration only; cognitive activity (single-deliverable thought) remains engineer's responsibility. Workflow files at <repo>/.agentic-plugins/state/orchestrator/workflows/ (legacy <repo>/.claude/agentic-orchestrator/workflows/ remains readable until explicit migration per ADR-0025) with schema '1.1' (distinct from engineer's schema '1.1' by structural validation — orchestrator requires workflow_type=macro + plan.subtasks[]). Codex can read/write the same state via skills, and bundled Codex lifecycle hooks can re-inject SessionStart metadata once the plugin is enabled with generic `[features].hooks` (default on) plus `/hooks` review/trust. Cross-host --peer dispatch for /orchestrator:next remains trigger-deferred PR-F scope.
defaultPrompt: $orchestrator:plan Implement schema 1.1 → 1.2 reader/writer migration as a multi-deliverable feature
